rule: Each fact is an exact literal quote from the drawn section. A case answers a fact when the delivered source rows of a catalogued document cover one verbatim occurrence of the quote: the union of the rows' exact character spans contains it (long lines arrive as adjacent windows, so a quote may straddle two rows). Any verbatim occurrence counts (see witness-audit.json). All facts of a topic are required for a fully answered case.

`doc-atlas qdrant up` | Download the pinned Qdrant binary

topics.note: The drawn section lists docatlas.yaml options, not separate commands; gold is those options.

facts.quote: `retrieval.hierarchical.enabled: true` switches the dispatcher to a two-stage retrieval
`retrieval.routers` is an ordered list of `{match: <regex>, filters: {...}}` entries.
`retrieval.expand: adjacent` (or `page`) plumbs neighbor expansion through hybrid mode
`web_fetch.workers` | `8` | Parallelism for web page fetching
`web_fetch.default_page_cap` | `500` | Default maximum pages for URL sources
`web_fetch.browser_fallback` | `false` | Enable Playwright browser fallback by default
